messages:
Alex Mendez: Quick sync: final prep for onboarding aurora-3b-v2 into the catalog tomorrow morning. Need a short pass on weights URI correctness, tokenizer mapping (we saw a mismatch earlier in staging), and the canary region plan. tagging owners so we can close blockers. @Priya @Rafael

Priya Srinivasan: For weights, do we want them in s3 or in our OCI model registry? I can push to either. Also need to confirm we include sha256 digest in the manifest for integrity checks.

Rafael Gomez: The current manifest points at `s3://rw-models/aurora/aurora-3b-v2/weights.bin` but that's without versioning or digest. I'll update to `s3://rw-models/aurora/aurora-3b-v2/2.0/weights.bin#sha256=...` and add a `storage_type: s3` field. Priya if you can upload and give me the object digest I will patch the manifest.

Emily Chen: Heads-up: when I ran `rwctl catalog lint --model aurora-3b-v2 --env=staging` it failed on schema: unknown key `quant_profiles` and missing `tokenizer_aliases`. Output below:
```
ERROR: catalog schema mismatch
model: aurora-3b-v2
- spec.tokenization: missing required 'tokenizer_aliases'
- spec.optim: unrecognized key 'quant_profiles'
```
We need to decide whether to remove `quant_profiles` or update the validator.

Tom H.: Prefer to avoid infra validator changes right before rollout. Option: strip `quant_profiles` from the initial manifest and keep a documented follow-up to reintroduce. Also want to limit canary scope initially to one region and low traffic.

Alex Mendez: Agreed. Rafael, can you add tokenizer aliases mapping so runtime picks up the right artifact? Also add runtime_hints to guide KV cache and instance sizing. For canary: start 5% traffic in `eu-central-1` only, ramp to 20% over 2 hours if metrics good. Fallback order should be: `aurora-3b-v2.int8`, then `aurora-3b-v1`.

Rafael Gomez: Will add a `tokenizer_aliases` block. Staging logs showed the runtime tried to load `hf/aurora3b` which doesn't exist in artifact store; actual artifact id is `aurora-v2-spm`. I'll map "hf/aurora3b": "aurora-v2-spm". Adding runtime hints too: `kv_cache_mb: 16000` suggested for dedicated, but for hosted canary we'll keep `kv_cache_mb: 8000`. I'll post a manifest diff after upload.

Priya Srinivasan: Uploading now to `s3://rw-models/aurora/aurora-3b-v2/2.0/weights.bin`. Setting object ACL to `catalog-service-read` and adding tag `cost-center:platform`. Will paste presigned URL once available.

canary-bot: Canary scheduled: aurora-3b-v2 at 2026-03-19T07:30:00Z (region: eu-central-1, initial: 5%, ramp to 20%). Monitoring hooks: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost. Rollback triggers configured.

Emily Chen: After Rafael's patch I'll re-run lint. If validator still flags `quant_profiles` we should remove it for the initial rollout (agreed). Also will run a quick smoke matrix: 10 prompts x 3 lengths, compare top-k consistency vs baseline.

Tom H.: I'll create the canary routing policy: start 5% in eu-central-1; auto-ramp to 20% over 2h if p95 < 300ms and error_rate < 0.8%. Fallbacks wired as Rafael suggested. Alerting: page on >1% sustained errors for 5m.

Rafael Gomez: Manifest PR opened: https://git.company/repo/catalog/pulls/598 — includes weights URI with digest placeholder, tokenizer_aliases, runtime_hints, routing.canary config and fallback list. I removed `quant_profiles` per Emily's preference. Please review.

Priya Srinivasan: Uploaded and confirmed digest: sha256:6f2b9c... Link shared in #eng-platform-private. ACLs and tag applied.

Emily Chen: Linting after Rafael's PR now passes in staging. Running smoke tests now; will post results in ~15m.

Tom H.: Canary route created in control plane and passive monitors hooked to dashboards. Will flip initial traffic at scheduled time and monitor automated checks.

Alex Mendez: Owners/ops: Priya = weights upload + ACLs + digest; Rafael = manifest edits + PR; Emily = validator/lint + smoke tests; Tom = routing + canary automation + alerting. I'll be on-call during the first 60m of the ramp.

Emily Chen: Smoke results: 10/10 success, p95 latency 210ms in staging, semantic diff small (0.8% divergence vs baseline on top-1). No obvious tokenizer artifacts.

Rafael Gomez: Merged PR after approvals. Kept a commented block in manifest with `quant_profiles` for re-introduction later.

canary-bot: Canary started: aurora-3b-v2, 5% traffic in eu-central-1. Monitoring active.

Tom H.: Seeing steady metrics, p95 225ms, errors 0.4%. Proceeding with automated ramp to 20% over next 2h. If anything spikes I'll flip fallback.

Alex Mendez: Thanks team. Post-rollout checklist: confirm cost attribution, confirm logs tagged, close PR and onboarding doc. If anyone sees unusual behavior tag me. :thumbsup:
